forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: e680
+title: review batch budget measures raw bytes but the prime renders numbered, blamed lines
+---
+Two related defects found while investigating ^k5wsxh0.
+
+## 1. The batch budget is measured against the wrong thing
+
+`batch_work_list` (`crates/swissarmyhammer-validators/src/review/scope.rs`) packs files by `source_slice.len()` — the raw bytes. But `render_numbered_source` (`crates/swissarmyhammer-validators/src/review/fleet.rs`) emits `{line:>6} | {sha:8} {mark} | {text}` per line, roughly 16 extra bytes per line.
+
+`DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE` was raised to 384 KiB on the reasoning that ~35-byte average lines expand about 1.45x. That ratio is content dependent. A file of 10-byte average lines expands closer to 2.6x, so the headroom does not actually bound the rendered prime. The packing is deterministic; the budget is simply a proxy that can be exceeded.
+
+Fix: budget the rendered size, or derive the budget from line count as well as byte count.
+
+## 2. Two doc comments describe behavior that was removed
+
+`batch_work_list` now returns `(Vec<WorkList>, Vec<SkippedFile>)` and reports oversized files as skipped gaps. Two comments still claim it hard-errors:
+
+- `crates/swissarmyhammer-validators/src/review/fleet.rs`, on `render_file_block`: "A file too large for the review `batch_size` never reaches here as a partial view: the scope stage rejects it with a hard error rather than trimming it to a slice."
+- `crates/swissarmyhammer-validators/src/review/scope.rs`, above the source-slice assembly: "A file too large for the review `batch_size` is never trimmed here — [`batch_work_list`] rejects it."
+
+`synthesize.rs` documents the new behavior correctly, so these two are the stale copies.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- The budget bounds the rendered prime, with a test over a short-line file that the raw-byte budget would have let through.
+- Both doc comments describe the skip-and-report behavior the code has.
+
+#bug #review
\ No newline at end of file
